primary_selection_rule: Select the first policy-eligible full-route checkpoint that satisfies provenance, feature-audit, Docker preflight, and no-held-out-selection gates. Do not choose among checkpoints using H001 held-out metric results.
reselection_rule: Changing the primary checkpoint after H001 held-out metric inspection requires a new schema version and must be reported as a deviation.

route_priority.rule: primary checkpoint if full route completes after official BLIP TopK5/scales3 feature audit pass
fallback for debugging/reporting progress; not final paper result unless full route is explicitly abandoned and claim is downgraded
may validate plumbing only; never promote to paper-result evidence

allowed_selection_signals: training-internal train/validation logs that do not include H001 held-out scans
forbidden_selection_signals: visual inspection of H001 held-out Open3DSG predictions
